design: Randomized common-frame and differential phase injections on three channels: signal, independent phase reference, path-matched bypass/null

exact_certificate.monitor_event_count_details: two monitor channels x four phase settings x 3e9 trials each, 99% simultaneous complex-error <=1e-4; 16 exp(-7.5)<.01
exact_certificate.null_identifiability: without independent bound on delta_signal-delta_null, extra physical phase and unmatched optical drift are observationally equivalent
exact_certificate.three_tone_identifiability: conventional three-frequency model with omega_k=2g_k and weights r_k reproduces Z(t) identically for all t; model families observationally identical under same noise/controls
exact_certificate.visibility_phase_invariance: common theta cancels in S/N and S/R; differential delta_signal-delta_null survives S/N

failure_case: delta_signal=0.002,delta_null=0,reference theta arbitrary: path-null estimator retains exactly 0.002 rad bias despite matching fringe visibility
scope: synthetic design and conditional mathematical receiver; no lab acquisition, measured photon rates, native physical time, or independent physics test
